source_document: Espina (2018), Planning for Climate Resilient Barangays in the Philippines: The Case of Barangay Tumana in Marikina City, Metro Manila
reported_depth_note: Eastern portion reported inundated by >2.5 m floodwater.
limitations: Source map is a published/embedded figure rather than original GIS data.

The extracted image has no native CRS/georeferencing metadata.
Do not use as calibration geometry until georeferencing and digitization are QC-checked.
Ecological Profile 2020 demographics are context/cross-check data and must not be treated as 2009/2013 historical demographics.
